crossRefs.note: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them.
Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…
Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
crossRefs.keyword: with all diligence. Heb. above all keeping

crossRefs.note: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:

crossRefs.note: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
crossRefs.keyword: with all diligence. Heb. above all keeping

crossRefs.note: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
crossRefs.keyword: with all diligence. Heb. above all keeping

crossRefs.note: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
crossRefs.keyword: with all diligence. Heb. above all keeping

crossRefs.note: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil…
For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

translations.web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
translations.bsb: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
translations.kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
translations.asv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.
